name: CachyOS Gaming
description: Adds the CachyOS repositories below the Arch repositories, so Arch packages stay authoritative and nothing in the Arch userland is converted. Installs the x86-64-v3 CachyOS kernel beside the Arch kernel, which stays available as the fallback; choose the CachyOS kernel in the boot menu and Limine remembers it. Includes CachyOS system tuning with ananicy-cpp and its rules, sched-ext schedulers, Steam, and CachyOS gaming packages: Proton-CachyOS, Wine-CachyOS, umu-launcher, winetricks, and protontricks. Requires an x86-64-v3 CPU. NVIDIA users on the open driver should also install linux-cachyos-nvidia-open. Arch only.
